text: Decomposed the user-supplied full-codebase review into 20 independently closable remediation items. The tracker records the underlying contract defects rather than copying two overstatements literally: the current SSH adapter launches one agent process per RPC, and the client applies the returned maximum frame size, so the work targets correlated per-request failure containment plus authoritative end-to-end response budgeting. AttemptEpoch is retained as an explicit design-resolution item because it is required by the PRD; the item asks for a reachable lifecycle or a documented v1 fencing role rather than assuming deletion.
